id: title:Gilbert09:mobile close the dismiss sheet before the write lands

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a Zustand store and shared state management for the DismissReportSheet component, retaining user input and error state across unmounts and API failures.
review.reason: Adds a new Zustand store, useDismissDraftStore, with a drafts record and a setDraft action. Replaces the component's internal useState and error handling with the shared store, and removes the pending-state-dependent UI, replacing it with a promise-based, unmounted-safe completion.
review.uncertainty: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the shared store or the complete DismissReportSheet component, so the exact behavior and the relationship between the store and the component cannot be fully established.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the shared store or the complete DismissReportSheet component, so the exact behavior and the relationship between the store and the component cannot be fully established. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new Zustand store, useDismissDraftStore, with a drafts record and a setDraft action.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a shared, client-side state store for preserving dismissal drafts and errors, allowing the DismissReportSheet to retain user input and error state across component unmounts and API failures.

observations.behavior: Replaces the component's internal useState and error handling with the shared store, and removes the pending-state-dependent UI, replacing it with a promise-based, unmounted-safe completion.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the DismissReportSheet to retain user input and error state across component unmounts and API failures, and to complete the dismissal even after the component unmounts.
